invariant: Java resolves state stereotypes in three independent stages. CommandCreateState maps only choice, fork, join, start, end, history, and history* case-insensitively to special leaf images. Entity.getEntityPosition maps only port and the entry, exit, pin, and expansion-position stereotypes away from NORMAL; Entity.isAutarkic tests that semantic position and cross-boundary links, not mere stereotype presence. EntityPosition then supplies the complete non-normal image model: entry and exit points are 12px circles, input and output pins are 12px squares, and top-to-bottom expansion inputs and outputs are 48x12 compartmented rectangles; only entry and exit points request Graphviz port P. EntityImageStateBorder paints every non-normal position and places its description outside the owning cluster. For an autarkic group, GroupMakerState still builds its autonomous image, and ordinary leaf descriptions remain part of EntityImageState content rather than invalidating autonomy. EntityImageStateCommon and InnerStateAutonom merge the base state/title/header/body signatures with the entity or group stereotype. Legacy StateAttributeFontName, StateAttributeFontSize, and StateAttributeFontStyle conversions feed the state title/header signatures as well as description text. ValueImpl.asFontFace recognizes exact bold, italic, plain/normal, or numeric-weight values; an unrecognized compound such as 'bold italic' resolves to the normal face. The merged font metrics determine each image dimension before SvekNode emits DOT dimensions, while merged fill, line, text, stroke, rounding, and shadow channels paint that same image. Explicit entity colors and strokes override merged style channels. An unmatched selector and an ordinary unmatched stereotype therefore leave geometry and paint unchanged.
causal_divergence: Rust preserves an ordinary stereotype string but originally rejected every stereotyped composite and every stereotyped child before autonomous layout, regardless of semantic entity position or image kind. It also accepted only nodesep and ranksep in the autonomous path, so any state style selector forced a different renderer even when the selector matched no entity. The first implementation corrected ordinary style resolution but retained three model gaps exposed by independent held-outs: it still rejected described autonomous leaves despite already sizing their descriptions; it substring-matched FontStyle and kept Font* ahead of AttributeFont* for title metrics, unlike Java's typed style conversion and state title/header signatures; and it excluded pin and expansion stereotypes from autonomy without carrying their semantic EntityPosition through the general cluster renderer, which then painted them as ordinary boxes.
planned_change: Recognize Java's reserved pseudostate stereotypes case-insensitively in the parser. Replace blanket stereotype rejection with a semantic autonomous-eligibility predicate: non-normal position stereotypes remain outside this autonomous renderer, while ordinary style stereotypes are eligible; specialized image decorations that Rust does not yet generate remain explicitly unsupported rather than silently painted as plain boxes. Resolve each ordinary state and composite from the diagram base style plus its matching stereotype-qualified state skinparams. Feed the resolved title and attribute font metrics into node and wrapper dimensions before layout, and use the same resolved fill, border, text, thickness, rounding, and shadow channels during emission, preserving explicit entity fill/stroke precedence. Preserve described ordinary leaves in autonomous images and emit their already-modelled attribute text below the divider. Mirror ValueImpl.asFontFace with exact-value parsing, and let qualified AttributeFont* properties override qualified Font* properties for the state title and description channels produced by Java's state title/header signatures. Introduce one semantic state-position classifier for entry, exit, input pin, output pin, expansion input, and expansion output stereotypes; use its Java dimensions, symbol, input/output cluster registration, label placement, and port-P behavior throughout the non-autarkic cluster renderer. Treat unmatched state selectors as inert for autonomous eligibility. Do not branch on fixture labels, special-case a stereotype merely because it appears in the golden corpus, or allow a visual value to alter geometry unless the corresponding Java style channel does.
